parameters.query:
WITH entrada AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS p
), datos AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(p->>'reserva_draft_id_metadata','') AS draft_id,
    NULLIF(p->>'subscriber_id_metadata','') AS subscriber_id,
    lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(p->>'email_pago',''),'')) AS email,
    lower(regexp_replace(trim(COALESCE(p->>'nombre_pago','')), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS nombre
  FROM entrada
), activas_exactas AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(d) AS registro, 'activa_exacta'::text AS origen
  FROM public.reservas_draft d CROSS JOIN entrada e
  WHERE (
    (NULLIF(e.p->>'reserva_draft_id_metadata','') IS NOT NULL
      AND d.id::text=e.p->>'reserva_draft_id_metadata')
    OR (NULLIF(e.p->>'subscriber_id_metadata','') IS NOT NULL
      AND d.subscriber_id::text=e.p->>'subscriber_id_metadata')
    OR (NULLIF(e.p->>'stripe_checkout_session_id','') IS NOT NULL
      AND d.stripe_checkout_session_id=e.p->>'stripe_checkout_session_id')
    OR (NULLIF(e.p->>'referencia_cliente','') IS NOT NULL
      AND (d.subscriber_id::text=e.p->>'referencia_cliente' OR d.id::text=e.p->>'referencia_cliente'))
  )
  AND (NULLIF(e.p->>'subscriber_id_metadata','') IS NULL
       OR d.subscriber_id::text=e.p->>'subscriber_id_metadata')
), activas_por_correo AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(d) || jsonb_build_object('origen_asociacion_stripe','activa_por_correo') AS registro,
         'activa_por_correo'::text AS origen
  FROM public.reservas_draft d CROSS JOIN datos p
  WHERE p.draft_id IS NULL AND p.subscriber_id IS NULL AND p.email <> ''
    AND lower(COALESCE(d.email,''))=p.email
    AND COALESCE(d.pago_recibido,false)=false
    AND COALESCE(d.reserva_confirmada,false)=false
    AND lower(COALESCE(d.estado_reserva,'')) NOT IN ('confirmado','cancelando_expirada','expirado_sin_pago','cancelado')
    AND COALESCE(d.masaje_inicio,d.jacuzzi_inicio) >= CURRENT_DATE
), activas_por_nombre AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(d) || jsonb_build_object('origen_asociacion_stripe','activa_por_nombre') AS registro,
         'activa_por_nombre'::text AS origen
  FROM public.reservas_draft d CROSS JOIN datos p
  WHERE p.draft_id IS NULL AND p.subscriber_id IS NULL
    AND p.nombre <> '' AND array_length(string_to_array(p.nombre,' '),1) >= 2
    AND lower(regexp_replace(trim(COALESCE(d.nombre,'')), '\s+', ' ', 'g'))=p.nombre
    AND COALESCE(d.pago_recibido,false)=false
    AND COALESCE(d.reserva_confirmada,false)=false
    AND lower(COALESCE(d.estado_reserva,'')) NOT IN ('confirmado','cancelando_expirada','expirado_sin_pago','cancelado')
    AND COALESCE(d.masaje_inicio,d.jacuzzi_inicio) >= CURRENT_DATE
), activas_tardias AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(d) || jsonb_build_object(
    'estado_reserva','pago_stripe_tardio_recuperable',
    'origen_asociacion_stripe','activo_tardio',
    'pago_stripe_tardio',true
  ) AS registro, 'activo_tardio'::text AS origen
  FROM public.reservas_draft d CROSS JOIN datos p
  WHERE p.draft_id IS NULL AND p.subscriber_id IS NULL AND p.email <> ''
    AND lower(COALESCE(d.email,''))=p.email
    AND d.estado_reserva='expirado_sin_pago'
    AND COALESCE(d.pago_recibido,false)=false AND COALESCE(d.reserva_confirmada,false)=false
    AND COALESCE(d.pabau_reservado,false)=false AND d.retencion_cancelada_at IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(d.evento_stripe_id,'') IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(d.monto_pagado,0)=0
    AND COALESCE(d.masaje_inicio,d.jacuzzi_inicio) >= CURRENT_DATE
), historicas_exactas AS (
  SELECT h.datos_originales || jsonb_build_object(
    'id',h.reserva_draft_id,
    'origen_asociacion_stripe','historico_exacto',
    'recuperacion_historica',true,
    'pago_stripe_tardio',true
  ) AS registro, 'historico_exacto'::text AS origen
  FROM public.reservas_draft_historico h CROSS JOIN entrada e
  WHERE jsonb_typeof(h.datos_originales)='object'
    AND (
      (NULLIF(e.p->>'reserva_draft_id_metadata','') IS NOT NULL
       AND h.reserva_draft_id::text=e.p->>'reserva_draft_id_metadata')
      OR (NULLIF(e.p->>'subscriber_id_metadata','') IS NOT NULL
       AND h.datos_originales->>'subscriber_id'=e.p->>'subscriber_id_metadata')
    )
    AND COALESCE((h.datos_originales->>'pago_recibido')::boolean,false)=false
    AND NULLIF(h.datos_originales->>'evento_stripe_id','') IS NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.reservas_draft d
      WHERE d.id=h.reserva_draft_id
    )
), historicas_por_correo AS (
  SELECT h.datos_originales || jsonb_build_object(
    'id',h.reserva_draft_id,
    'origen_asociacion_stripe','historico_por_correo',
    'recuperacion_historica',true,
    'pago_stripe_tardio',true
  ) AS registro, 'historico_por_correo'::text AS origen
  FROM public.reservas_draft_historico h CROSS JOIN datos p
  WHERE p.draft_id IS NULL AND p.subscriber_id IS NULL AND p.email <> ''
    AND jsonb_typeof(h.datos_originales)='object'
    AND lower(COALESCE(h.datos_originales->>'email',h.datos_originales->>'correo',''))=p.email
    AND h.archivado_en >= statement_timestamp()-interval '24 hours'
    AND h.datos_originales->>'estado_reserva'='expirado_sin_pago'
    AND COALESCE((h.datos_originales->>'pago_recibido')::boolean,false)=false
    AND COALESCE((h.datos_originales->>'reserva_confirmada')::boolean,false)=false
    AND NULLIF(h.datos_originales->>'evento_stripe_id','') IS NULL
    AND COALESCE((h.datos_originales->>'monto_pagado')::numeric,0)=0
    AND COALESCE(
      NULLIF(h.datos_originales->>'masaje_inicio','')::timestamp,
      NULLIF(h.datos_originales->>'jacuzzi_inicio','')::timestamp
    ) >= CURRENT_DATE
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.reservas_draft d
      WHERE d.id=h.reserva_draft_id
    )
), historicas_tardias AS (
  SELECT h.datos_originales || jsonb_build_object(
    'id',h.reserva_draft_id,
    'estado_reserva','pago_stripe_tardio_recuperable',
    'origen_asociacion_stripe','historico_tardio',
    'recuperacion_historica',true,
    'pago_stripe_tardio',true
  ) AS registro, 'historico_tardio'::text AS origen
  FROM public.reservas_draft_historico h CROSS JOIN datos p
  WHERE p.draft_id IS NULL AND p.subscriber_id IS NULL AND p.email <> ''
    AND jsonb_typeof(h.datos_originales)='object'
    AND lower(COALESCE(h.datos_originales->>'email',h.datos_originales->>'correo',''))=p.email
    AND h.archivado_en >= statement_timestamp()-interval '24 hours'
    AND h.datos_originales->>'estado_reserva'='expirado_sin_pago'
    AND COALESCE((h.datos_originales->>'pago_recibido')::boolean,false)=false
    AND COALESCE((h.datos_originales->>'reserva_confirmada')::boolean,false)=false
    AND NULLIF(h.datos_originales->>'evento_stripe_id','') IS NULL
    AND COALESCE((h.datos_originales->>'monto_pagado')::numeric,0)=0
    AND COALESCE(
      NULLIF(h.datos_originales->>'masaje_inicio','')::timestamp,
      NULLIF(h.datos_originales->>'jacuzzi_inicio','')::timestamp
    ) >= CURRENT_DATE
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.reservas_draft d
      WHERE d.id=h.reserva_draft_id
    )
), candidatas AS (
  SELECT registro,origen FROM activas_por_correo
  UNION ALL SELECT registro,origen FROM activas_por_nombre
  UNION ALL SELECT registro,origen FROM activas_tardias
  UNION ALL SELECT registro,origen FROM historicas_por_correo
  UNION ALL SELECT registro,origen FROM historicas_tardias
), candidatos_unicos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (registro->>'id') registro,origen
  FROM candidatas
  ORDER BY registro->>'id', origen
), seleccion AS (
  SELECT registro,origen FROM activas_exactas
    WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM activas_exactas)=1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT registro,origen FROM activas_por_correo
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_exactas)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM activas_por_correo)=1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT registro,origen FROM activas_por_nombre
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_exactas)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_por_correo)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM activas_por_nombre)=1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT registro,origen FROM activas_tardias
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_exactas)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_por_correo)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_por_nombre)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM activas_tardias)=1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT registro,origen FROM historicas_exactas
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_exactas)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_por_correo)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_por_nombre)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_tardias)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM historicas_exactas)=1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT registro,origen FROM historicas_por_correo
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_exactas)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_por_correo)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_por_nombre)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_tardias)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM historicas_exactas)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM historicas_por_correo)=1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT registro,origen FROM historicas_tardias
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_exactas)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_por_correo)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_por_nombre)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_tardias)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM historicas_exactas)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM historicas_por_correo)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM historicas_tardias)=1
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT registro FROM seleccion LIMIT 1),'{}'::jsonb) AS registro,
       COALESCE((SELECT origen FROM seleccion LIMIT 1),'ninguno') AS origen_asociacion_stripe,
       COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(registro) FROM candidatos_unicos),'[]'::jsonb) AS candidatos,
       (SELECT p FROM entrada) AS pago_entrada,
       EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM public.reservas r
         WHERE r.stripe_checkout_session_id = (SELECT p->>'stripe_checkout_session_id' FROM entrada)
       ) AS pago_ya_en_reservas;

parameters.query:
-- Una sola transacciÃ³n: copiar, verificar y eliminar exactamente el borrador recibido.
WITH entrada AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j),
origen AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.* FROM public.reservas_draft d, entrada e
  WHERE d.id::text = e.j->>'id'
    AND d.subscriber_id::text = e.j->>'subscriber_id'
    AND e.j->>'pago_validado' = 'true'
    AND e.j->>'notas_pabau_actualizadas' = 'true'
    AND d.estado_reserva = 'confirmado'
    AND d.pago_recibido IS TRUE AND d.reserva_confirmada IS TRUE
    AND d.pabau_reservado IS TRUE
    AND d.stripe_checkout_session_id = e.j->>'stripe_checkout_session_id'
    AND d.stripe_checkout_session_id ~ '^cs_(live|test)_'
    AND NULLIF(d.stripe_payment_intent_id, '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(d.evento_stripe_id, '') IS NOT NULL
    AND d.monto_pagado > 0
    AND d.monto_pagado = (e.j->>'monto_pagado')::numeric
    AND upper(d.moneda_pago) = upper(e.j->>'moneda_pago')
    AND d.sucursal = e.j->>'sucursal'
    AND d.jacuzzi_inicio IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (e.j->>'jacuzzi_inicio')::timestamp
    AND d.masaje_inicio IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (e.j->>'masaje_inicio')::timestamp
    AND (jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(d.pabau_citas_agua_ids, '[]'::jsonb))
       + jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(d.pabau_citas_masaje_ids, '[]'::jsonb))) > 0
  FOR UPDATE OF d
),
insertada AS (
  INSERT INTO public.reservas (contact_id, subscriber_id, recurso_agua_asignado, cabinas_asignadas, camillas, terapeutas_necesarios, jacuzzi_inicio, masaje_inicio, terapeuta_1, terapeuta_2, terapeuta_3, sucursal, terapeuta_4, terapeuta_5, terapeuta_6, disponible, link_enviado, pago_recibido, reserva_confirmada, fecha_pago, phone, email, service_agua_id, service_terapeuta_id, nombre, nombre_servicio, stripe_checkout_session_id, stripe_payment_intent_id, evento_stripe_id, pabau_reservado, pabau_confirmado_at, cabinas_disponibles, cabinas_mixtas, rooftop_pendiente_configuracion, rooftop_recurso_id, rooftop_interviene_disponibilidad, monto_pagado, moneda_pago, pabau_citas_agua_ids, pabau_citas_masaje_ids)
  SELECT d.contact_id, d.subscriber_id, d.recurso_agua_asignado, d.cabinas_asignadas, d.camillas, d.terapeutas_necesarios, d.jacuzzi_inicio, d.masaje_inicio, d.terapeuta_1, d.terapeuta_2, d.terapeuta_3, d.sucursal, d.terapeuta_4, d.terapeuta_5, d.terapeuta_6, d.disponible, d.link_enviado, d.pago_recibido, d.reserva_confirmada, d.fecha_pago, d.phone, d.email, d.service_agua_id, d.service_terapeuta_id, d.nombre, d.nombre_servicio, d.stripe_checkout_session_id, d.stripe_payment_intent_id, d.evento_stripe_id, d.pabau_reservado, d.pabau_confirmado_at, d.cabinas_disponibles, d.cabinas_mixtas, d.rooftop_pendiente_configuracion, d.rooftop_recurso_id, d.rooftop_interviene_disponibilidad, d.monto_pagado, d.moneda_pago, d.pabau_citas_agua_ids, d.pabau_citas_masaje_ids FROM origen d
  ON CONFLICT (stripe_checkout_session_id)
    WHERE stripe_checkout_session_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
  RETURNING *
),
destino AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT r.* FROM insertada r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.* FROM public.reservas r JOIN origen d
    ON r.stripe_checkout_session_id = d.stripe_checkout_session_id
),
verificada AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT r.id AS reserva_id, d.id AS draft_id FROM destino r JOIN origen d
    ON r.subscriber_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.subscriber_id
    AND r.contact_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.contact_id
    AND r.sucursal IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.sucursal
    AND r.jacuzzi_inicio IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.jacuzzi_inicio
    AND r.masaje_inicio IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.masaje_inicio
    AND r.service_agua_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.service_agua_id
    AND r.service_terapeuta_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.service_terapeuta_id
    AND r.recurso_agua_asignado IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.recurso_agua_asignado
    AND r.terapeutas_necesarios IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.terapeutas_necesarios
    AND r.camillas IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.camillas
    AND r.terapeuta_1 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.terapeuta_1
    AND r.terapeuta_2 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.terapeuta_2
    AND r.terapeuta_3 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.terapeuta_3
    AND r.terapeuta_4 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.terapeuta_4
    AND r.terapeuta_5 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.terapeuta_5
    AND r.terapeuta_6 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.terapeuta_6
    AND r.nombre IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.nombre
    AND r.email IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.email

-- Un reenvÃ­o del mismo evento no crea reservas ni repite mensajes.
WITH entrada AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j),

    AND r.terapeuta_2 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.terapeuta_2
    AND r.terapeuta_3 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.terapeuta_3
    AND r.terapeuta_4 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.terapeuta_4
    AND r.terapeuta_5 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.terapeuta_5
    AND r.terapeuta_6 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.terapeuta_6
    AND r.nombre IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.nombre
    AND r.email IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.email
    AND r.phone IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.phone
    AND r.nombre_servicio IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.nombre_servicio
    AND r.pago_recibido IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.pago_recibido
    AND r.reserva_confirmada IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.reserva_confirmada
    AND r.pabau_reservado IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.pabau_reservado
    AND r.stripe_checkout_session_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.stripe_checkout_session_id
    AND r.stripe_payment_intent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.stripe_payment_intent_id
    AND r.evento_stripe_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.evento_stripe_id
    AND r.monto_pagado IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.monto_pagado
    AND r.moneda_pago IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.moneda_pago
    AND r.pabau_citas_agua_ids IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.pabau_citas_agua_ids
    AND r.pabau_citas_masaje_ids IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.pabau_citas_masaje_ids
  RETURNING x.id
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'pago_ya_procesado', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM destino),
  'borrador_eliminado', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eliminada),
  'borrador_ya_ausente', NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM origen),
  'reserva_id', (SELECT id FROM destino),
  'reserva_draft_id', (SELECT j->>'reserva_draft_id' FROM entrada),

) AS resultado;

WITH entrada AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS p
), archivo AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT h.reserva_draft_id,h.datos_originales
  FROM public.reservas_draft_historico h CROSS JOIN entrada e
  WHERE h.reserva_draft_id=(e.p->>'id')::bigint
    AND jsonb_typeof(h.datos_originales)='object'
    AND h.datos_originales->>'estado_reserva'='expirado_sin_pago'
    AND COALESCE((h.datos_originales->>'pago_recibido')::boolean,false)=false
    AND NULLIF(h.datos_originales->>'evento_stripe_id','') IS NULL
    AND (
      -- Una referencia exacta al borrador es suficiente aunque el cliente
      -- haya usado otro correo al pagar.
      (e.p->>'origen_asociacion_stripe'='historico_exacto')
      OR lower(COALESCE(h.datos_originales->>'email',h.datos_originales->>'correo',''))
         =lower(COALESCE(e.p->>'email_pago',''))
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.reservas_draft d WHERE d.id=h.reserva_draft_id)
  FOR UPDATE
), preparado AS (
  SELECT a.reserva_draft_id,
    a.datos_originales || jsonb_build_object(
      'id',a.reserva_draft_id,
      'pago_recibido',true,
      'reserva_confirmada',false,
      'estado_reserva','requiere_revision_pago',
      'pabau_reservado',false,
      'pabau_citas_agua_ids','[]'::jsonb,
      'pabau_citas_masaje_ids','[]'::jsonb,
      'stripe_checkout_session_id',e.p->>'stripe_checkout_session_id',
      'stripe_payment_intent_id',e.p->>'stripe_payment_intent_id',
      'evento_stripe_id',e.p->>'evento_stripe_id',
      'fecha_pago',COALESCE(NULLIF(e.p->>'fecha_evento_stripe',''),statement_timestamp()::text),
      'monto_pagado',(e.p->>'monto_total')::numeric/100,
      'moneda_pago',upper(COALESCE(e.p->>'moneda','MXN')),
      'retencion_expira_at',NULL,
      'procesando_desde',NULL,
      'motivo_revision','PAGO_STRIPE_TARDIO_REQUIERE_NUEVA_DISPONIBILIDAD'
    ) AS datos
  FROM archivo a CROSS JOIN entrada e
), insertada AS (
  INSERT INTO public.reservas_draft
  SELECT (jsonb_populate_record(NULL::public.reservas_draft,p.datos)).*
  FROM preparado p
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT COALESCE(
  (SELECT to_jsonb(i) FROM insertada i LIMIT 1),
  jsonb_build_object('restauracion_exitosa',false)
) AS resultado;

parameters.query:
WITH entrada AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS p
), datos AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(p->>'reserva_draft_id_metadata','') AS draft_id,
    NULLIF(p->>'subscriber_id_metadata','') AS subscriber_id,
    lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(p->>'email_pago',''),'')) AS email,
    lower(regexp_replace(trim(COALESCE(p->>'nombre_pago','')), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS nombre
  FROM entrada
), activas_exactas AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(d) AS registro, 'activa_exacta'::text AS origen
  FROM public.reservas_draft d CROSS JOIN entrada e
  WHERE (
    (NULLIF(e.p->>'reserva_draft_id_metadata','') IS NOT NULL
      AND d.id::text=e.p->>'reserva_draft_id_metadata')
    OR (NULLIF(e.p->>'subscriber_id_metadata','') IS NOT NULL
      AND d.subscriber_id::text=e.p->>'subscriber_id_metadata')
    OR (NULLIF(e.p->>'stripe_checkout_session_id','') IS NOT NULL
      AND d.stripe_checkout_session_id=e.p->>'stripe_checkout_session_id')
    OR (NULLIF(e.p->>'referencia_cliente','') IS NOT NULL
      AND (d.subscriber_id::text=e.p->>'referencia_cliente' OR d.id::text=e.p->>'referencia_cliente'))
  )
  AND (NULLIF(e.p->>'subscriber_id_metadata','') IS NULL
       OR d.subscriber_id::text=e.p->>'subscriber_id_metadata')
), activas_por_correo AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(d) || jsonb_build_object('origen_asociacion_stripe','activa_por_correo') AS registro,
         'activa_por_correo'::text AS origen
  FROM public.reservas_draft d CROSS JOIN datos p
  WHERE p.draft_id IS NULL AND p.subscriber_id IS NULL AND p.email <> ''
    AND lower(COALESCE(d.email,''))=p.email
    AND COALESCE(d.pago_recibido,false)=false
    AND COALESCE(d.reserva_confirmada,false)=false
    AND lower(COALESCE(d.estado_reserva,'')) NOT IN ('confirmado','cancelando_expirada','expirado_sin_pago','cancelado')
    AND COALESCE(d.masaje_inicio,d.jacuzzi_inicio) >= CURRENT_DATE
), activas_por_nombre AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(d) || jsonb_build_object('origen_asociacion_stripe','activa_por_nombre') AS registro,
         'activa_por_nombre'::text AS origen
  FROM public.reservas_draft d CROSS JOIN datos p
  WHERE p.draft_id IS NULL AND p.subscriber_id IS NULL
    AND p.nombre <> '' AND array_length(string_to_array(p.nombre,' '),1) >= 2
    AND lower(regexp_replace(trim(COALESCE(d.nombre,'')), '\s+', ' ', 'g'))=p.nombre
    AND COALESCE(d.pago_recibido,false)=false
    AND COALESCE(d.reserva_confirmada,false)=false
    AND lower(COALESCE(d.estado_reserva,'')) NOT IN ('confirmado','cancelando_expirada','expirado_sin_pago','cancelado')
    AND COALESCE(d.masaje_inicio,d.jacuzzi_inicio) >= CURRENT_DATE
), activas_tardias AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(d) || jsonb_build_object(
    'estado_reserva','pago_stripe_tardio_recuperable',
    'origen_asociacion_stripe','activo_tardio',
    'pago_stripe_tardio',true
  ) AS registro, 'activo_tardio'::text AS origen
  FROM public.reservas_draft d CROSS JOIN datos p
  WHERE p.draft_id IS NULL AND p.subscriber_id IS NULL AND p.email <> ''
    AND lower(COALESCE(d.email,''))=p.email
    AND d.estado_reserva='expirado_sin_pago'
    AND COALESCE(d.pago_recibido,false)=false AND COALESCE(d.reserva_confirmada,false)=false
    AND COALESCE(d.pabau_reservado,false)=false AND d.retencion_cancelada_at IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(d.evento_stripe_id,'') IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(d.monto_pagado,0)=0
    AND COALESCE(d.masaje_inicio,d.jacuzzi_inicio) >= CURRENT_DATE
), historicas_exactas AS (
  SELECT h.datos_originales || jsonb_build_object(
    'id',h.reserva_draft_id,
    'origen_asociacion_stripe','historico_exacto',
    'recuperacion_historica',true,
    'pago_stripe_tardio',true
  ) AS registro, 'historico_exacto'::text AS origen
  FROM public.reservas_draft_historico h CROSS JOIN entrada e
  WHERE jsonb_typeof(h.datos_originales)='object'
    AND (
      (NULLIF(e.p->>'reserva_draft_id_metadata','') IS NOT NULL
       AND h.reserva_draft_id::text=e.p->>'reserva_draft_id_metadata')
      OR (NULLIF(e.p->>'subscriber_id_metadata','') IS NOT NULL
       AND h.datos_originales->>'subscriber_id'=e.p->>'subscriber_id_metadata')
    )
    AND COALESCE((h.datos_originales->>'pago_recibido')::boolean,false)=false
    AND NULLIF(h.datos_originales->>'evento_stripe_id','') IS NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.reservas_draft d
      WHERE d.id=h.reserva_draft_id
    )
), historicas_por_correo AS (
  SELECT h.datos_originales || jsonb_build_object(
    'id',h.reserva_draft_id,
    'origen_asociacion_stripe','historico_por_correo',
    'recuperacion_historica',true,
    'pago_stripe_tardio',true
  ) AS registro, 'historico_por_correo'::text AS origen
  FROM public.reservas_draft_historico h CROSS JOIN datos p
  WHERE p.draft_id IS NULL AND p.subscriber_id IS NULL AND p.email <> ''
    AND jsonb_typeof(h.datos_originales)='object'
    AND lower(COALESCE(h.datos_originales->>'email',h.datos_originales->>'correo',''))=p.email
    AND h.archivado_en >= statement_timestamp()-interval '24 hours'
    AND h.datos_originales->>'estado_reserva'='expirado_sin_pago'
    AND COALESCE((h.datos_originales->>'pago_recibido')::boolean,false)=false
    AND COALESCE((h.datos_originales->>'reserva_confirmada')::boolean,false)=false
    AND NULLIF(h.datos_originales->>'evento_stripe_id','') IS NULL
    AND COALESCE((h.datos_originales->>'monto_pagado')::numeric,0)=0
    AND COALESCE(
      NULLIF(h.datos_originales->>'masaje_inicio','')::timestamp,
      NULLIF(h.datos_originales->>'jacuzzi_inicio','')::timestamp
    ) >= CURRENT_DATE
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.reservas_draft d
      WHERE d.id=h.reserva_draft_id
    )
), historicas_tardias AS (
  SELECT h.datos_originales || jsonb_build_object(
    'id',h.reserva_draft_id,
    'estado_reserva','pago_stripe_tardio_recuperable',
    'origen_asociacion_stripe','historico_tardio',
    'recuperacion_historica',true,
    'pago_stripe_tardio',true
  ) AS registro, 'historico_tardio'::text AS origen
  FROM public.reservas_draft_historico h CROSS JOIN datos p
  WHERE p.draft_id IS NULL AND p.subscriber_id IS NULL AND p.email <> ''
    AND jsonb_typeof(h.datos_originales)='object'
    AND lower(COALESCE(h.datos_originales->>'email',h.datos_originales->>'correo',''))=p.email
    AND h.archivado_en >= statement_timestamp()-interval '24 hours'
    AND h.datos_originales->>'estado_reserva'='expirado_sin_pago'
    AND COALESCE((h.datos_originales->>'pago_recibido')::boolean,false)=false
    AND COALESCE((h.datos_originales->>'reserva_confirmada')::boolean,false)=false
    AND NULLIF(h.datos_originales->>'evento_stripe_id','') IS NULL
    AND COALESCE((h.datos_originales->>'monto_pagado')::numeric,0)=0
    AND COALESCE(
      NULLIF(h.datos_originales->>'masaje_inicio','')::timestamp,
      NULLIF(h.datos_originales->>'jacuzzi_inicio','')::timestamp
    ) >= CURRENT_DATE
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.reservas_draft d
      WHERE d.id=h.reserva_draft_id
    )
), candidatas AS (
  SELECT registro,origen FROM activas_por_correo
  UNION ALL SELECT registro,origen FROM activas_por_nombre
  UNION ALL SELECT registro,origen FROM activas_tardias
  UNION ALL SELECT registro,origen FROM historicas_por_correo
  UNION ALL SELECT registro,origen FROM historicas_tardias
), candidatos_unicos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (registro->>'id') registro,origen
  FROM candidatas
  ORDER BY registro->>'id', origen
), seleccion AS (
  SELECT registro,origen FROM activas_exactas
    WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM activas_exactas)=1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT registro,origen FROM activas_por_correo
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_exactas)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM activas_por_correo)=1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT registro,origen FROM activas_por_nombre
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_exactas)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_por_correo)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM activas_por_nombre)=1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT registro,origen FROM activas_tardias
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_exactas)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_por_correo)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_por_nombre)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM activas_tardias)=1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT registro,origen FROM historicas_exactas
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_exactas)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_por_correo)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_por_nombre)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_tardias)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM historicas_exactas)=1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT registro,origen FROM historicas_por_correo
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_exactas)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_por_correo)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_por_nombre)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_tardias)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM historicas_exactas)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM historicas_por_correo)=1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT registro,origen FROM historicas_tardias
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_exactas)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_por_correo)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_por_nombre)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM activas_tardias)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM historicas_exactas)
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM historicas_por_correo)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM historicas_tardias)=1
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT registro FROM seleccion LIMIT 1),'{}'::jsonb) AS registro,
       COALESCE((SELECT origen FROM seleccion LIMIT 1),'ninguno') AS origen_asociacion_stripe,
       COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(registro) FROM candidatos_unicos),'[]'::jsonb) AS candidatos,
       (SELECT p FROM entrada) AS pago_entrada,
       EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM public.reservas r
         WHERE r.stripe_checkout_session_id = (SELECT p->>'stripe_checkout_session_id' FROM entrada)
       ) AS pago_ya_en_reservas;
